scares.description: The vampire attacks Stan from behind.
Sudden screaming is heard from Stan’s grandpa.
There is a loud musical accent as Stan opens the door.
Banging on the door and yelling wakes up Stan.
The vampire breaks through the door of the shed.
The vampire appears in the hole.
In a dream sequence, Roxy turns into the vampire.
In a second fake-out dream sequence, the vampire is under the bed.
Dommer bursts out of the shed.
